name: WP-CLI command
description: Adds a WP-CLI command class implementing the CLICommand interface from rtcamp/wp-framework. Static get_name / get_description / run; the consumer's Cli module wires it through WP_CLI::add_command().

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the command class. Default 'Inc\Cli' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\CLI') to override.
Directory for the command file. Default 'includes/Cli'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Cli'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Cli'.
Command slug, kebab- or snake-case, e.g. 'sync-feed'. Used as the WP-CLI command name.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.
One-line command description shown in `wp help`.
inputs.default: TODO: describe what this command does.

wiring.description: Add the command class to the Cli module. The module's register_hooks() should iterate get_classes() and call WP_CLI::add_command( $class::get_name(), $class::class ) when defined('WP_CLI'). If the Cli module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Cli --kind=cli`.
